labels.thanksTitle: Thank you for using PDF Text Replace!
labels.thanksSub: Your edited PDF was generated successfully. If we saved you a few minutes today, please tell a friend — that's how we keep the tool free.
labels.thanksShareIntro: Share with someone who could use this:
labels.noMatches: No matches found. Check capitalization and spacing.
labels.warnLonger: Heads up: your replacement text is longer than the original — it may overflow into nearby text.
labels.warnImage: Did your PDF come from a scanner? If text isn't selectable, this tool can't find it — you'll need an OCR step first.
labels.modeLabel: PDF type — pick what your file actually is
labels.modeVectorHint: Generated by software — Word, browser print-to-PDF, invoice tools, certificates. Pick this for almost all PDFs you didn't capture with a camera.
labels.modeScannedHint: Phone-photographed page or flatbed scan that was OCR'd. Use only if the visible text is rasterised pixels.
labels.weightHint: Tick if the original text is visibly bold or italic and our auto-detection got it wrong.
